fr.title: Appel de Bangkok : ce que les réunions annuelles du FMI et de la Banque mondiale pourraient signaler sur une économie mondiale fragile

segments.src: Finance ministers, central bankers and development officials are set to gather in Bangkok in mid-October for the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group.
segments.tr: Les ministres des Finances, les banquiers centraux et les responsables du développement doivent se réunir à Bangkok à la mi-octobre pour les réunions annuelles du Fonds monétaire international (FMI) et du Groupe de la Banque mondiale.

segments.src: The setting is a familiar one: a week of speeches, closed-door sessions and policy communiqués.
segments.tr: Le cadre est familier : une semaine de discours, de sessions à huis clos et de communiqués politiques.

segments.src: The backdrop is less familiar.
segments.tr: Le contexte l'est moins.

segments.src: Borrowing costs remain elevated in many markets, trade relationships are under strain, and conflict-related disruptions continue to influence energy prices.
segments.tr: Les coûts d'emprunt restent élevés sur de nombreux marchés, les relations commerciales sont sous tension et les perturbations liées aux conflits continuent d'influencer les prix de l'énergie.

segments.src: Together, these pressures shape how policymakers think about growth in the year ahead.
segments.tr: Ensemble, ces pressions façonnent la façon dont les décideurs politiques envisagent la croissance pour l'année à venir.

segments.src: This guide explains what the meetings are, which themes are likely to matter, and how to read the headlines without over-interpreting them.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique ce que sont ces réunions, quels thèmes sont susceptibles d'être importants et comment lire les gros titres sans les surinterpréter.

segments.src: ## Why These Meetings Matter
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ces réunions sont importantes

segments.src: The Annual Meetings bring together officials from nearly all of the institutions' member countries.
segments.tr: Les réunions annuelles rassemblent des responsables de la quasi-totalité des pays membres des institutions.

segments.src: They are not a place where binding decisions on the world economy are made in a single stroke.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas un lieu où des décisions contraignantes sur l'économie mondiale sont prises en une seule fois.

segments.src: Their value lies elsewhere:
segments.tr: Leur valeur réside ailleurs :

segments.src: - **Shared assessments.** The IMF publishes updated forecasts and risk assessments that governments, businesses and analysts use as a common reference point.
segments.tr: - **Évaluations partagées.** Le FMI publie des prévisions et des évaluations des risques actualisées que les gouvernements, les entreprises et les analystes utilisent comme point de référence commun.

segments.src: - **Coordination.** Officials meet bilaterally on the sidelines, which can move stalled negotiations forward, including those on debt.
segments.tr: - **Coordination.** Les responsables se rencontrent bilatéralement en marge des réunions, ce qui peut faire avancer les négociations bloquées, y compris celles sur la dette.

segments.src: - **Signaling.** The tone of communiqués and press conferences can indicate how officials weigh risks such as inflation, slower growth and financial stability.
segments.tr: - **Signalisation.** Le ton des communiqués et des conférences de presse peut indiquer comment les responsables évaluent les risques tels que l'inflation, le ralentissement de la croissance et la stabilité financière.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the IMF's Outlook
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller dans les perspectives du FMI

segments.src: The IMF's World Economic Outlook is typically released around the meetings.
segments.tr: Les Perspectives de l'économie mondiale du FMI sont généralement publiées autour des réunions.

segments.src: Several questions are worth keeping in mind when it appears.
segments.tr: Plusieurs questions méritent d'être gardées à l'esprit lors de leur parution.

segments.src: ### 1. Direction of the growth forecast
segments.tr: ### 1. Orientation des prévisions de croissance

segments.src: Look at whether global growth projections are revised up, down or left broadly unchanged compared with earlier editions.
segments.tr: Regardez si les projections de croissance mondiale sont révisées à la hausse, à la baisse ou laissées globalement inchangées par rapport aux éditions précédentes.

segments.src: Small changes are common and are often less important than the explanation attached to them.
segments.tr: Les petits changements sont courants et sont souvent moins importants que l'explication qui les accompagne.

segments.src: A forecast held steady because risks are balanced is different from one held steady despite growing concern.
segments.tr: Une prévision maintenue stable parce que les risques sont équilibrés est différente d'une prévision maintenue stable malgré des inquiétudes croissantes.

segments.src: ### 2. The balance of risks
segments.tr: ### 2. L'équilibre des risques

segments.src: The IMF usually describes risks as tilted to the downside, the upside or roughly balanced.
segments.tr: Le FMI décrit généralement les risques comme étant orientés à la baisse, à la hausse ou globalement équilibrés.

segments.src: Pay attention to which factors it names.
segments.tr: Faites attention aux facteurs qu'il nomme.

segments.src: Frequently cited candidates include:
segments.tr: Les candidats fréquemment cités incluent :

segments.src: - Persistently high long-term government bond yields
segments.tr: - Des rendements obligataires d'État à long terme durablement élevés

segments.src: - Trade restrictions and uncertainty about tariffs
segments.tr: - Des restrictions commerciales et une incertitude concernant les tarifs douaniers

segments.src: - Energy price swings linked to ongoing conflicts
segments.tr: - Des fluctuations des prix de l'énergie liées aux conflits en cours

segments.src: - Tightening or volatile financial conditions
segments.tr: - Des conditions financières plus strictes ou volatiles

segments.src: ### 3. Inflation and interest rates
segments.tr: ### 3. Inflation et taux d'intérêt

segments.src: Whether inflation is cooling toward central bank targets affects how quickly borrowing costs might ease.
segments.tr: Le fait que l'inflation ralentisse vers les objectifs des banques centrales affecte la rapidité avec laquelle les coûts d'emprunt pourraient diminuer.

segments.src: The IMF's commentary on the pace of disinflation, and on how far central banks should go in adjusting policy, is often one of the most closely read parts of the report.
segments.tr: Les commentaires du FMI sur le rythme de la désinflation, et sur la mesure dans laquelle les banques centrales devraient aller dans l'ajustement de leur politique, sont souvent l'une des parties les plus attentivement lues du rapport.

segments.src: ### 4. Differences between regions
segments.tr: ### 4. Différences entre les régions

segments.src: Advanced economies, emerging markets and low-income countries often face very different conditions.
segments.tr: Les économies avancées, les marchés émergents et les pays à faible revenu sont souvent confrontés à des conditions très différentes.

segments.src: Watch for how the report treats Asia, which is hosting the meetings, as well as energy-importing economies that are more exposed to price shocks.
segments.tr: Surveillez la façon dont le rapport traite l'Asie, qui accueille les réunions, ainsi que les économies importatrices d'énergie qui sont plus exposées aux chocs de prix.

segments.src: ## The Bond Yield Question
segments.tr: ## La question des rendements obligataires

segments.src: High yields on government debt matter well beyond bond traders.
segments.tr: Les rendements élevés de la dette publique importent bien au-delà des traders obligataires.

segments.src: When governments pay more to borrow, interest costs take up a larger share of budgets, leaving less room for spending on public services, infrastructure or support during downturns.
segments.tr: Lorsque les gouvernements paient plus pour emprunter, les coûts des intérêts occupent une part plus importante des budgets, laissant moins de place pour les dépenses liées aux services publics, aux infrastructures ou au soutien en période de ralentissement économique.

segments.src: Higher yields can also spill over into mortgage rates, corporate borrowing and the exchange rates of other countries.
segments.tr: Des rendements plus élevés peuvent également se répercuter sur les taux hypothécaires, les emprunts des entreprises et les taux de change d'autres pays.

segments.src: At the meetings, expect discussion of fiscal sustainability: how governments can put public finances on a steadier path without choking off growth.
segments.tr: Lors des réunions, attendez-vous à des discussions sur la viabilité budgétaire : comment les gouvernements peuvent mettre les finances publiques sur une voie plus stable sans étouffer la croissance.

segments.src: The IMF has long encouraged credible medium-term plans, and the language it uses on this topic can hint at how urgent it considers the issue.
segments.tr: Le FMI encourage depuis longtemps des plans crédibles à moyen terme, et le langage qu'il utilise sur ce sujet peut indiquer à quel point il considère la question comme urgente.

segments.src: ## Trade Friction
segments.tr: ## Friction commerciale

segments.src: Trade tensions are likely to feature in both formal sessions and informal conversations.
segments.tr: Les tensions commerciales seront probablement présentes à la fois dans les sessions formelles et dans les conversations informelles.

segments.src: Key points to follow include:
segments.tr: Les points clés à suivre incluent :

segments.src: - Whether the IMF quantifies the effect of trade barriers on growth and prices
segments.tr: - Si le FMI quantifie l'effet des barrières commerciales sur la croissance et les prix

segments.src: - How officials describe the risk of fragmentation into competing economic blocs
segments.tr: - Comment les responsables décrivent le risque de fragmentation en blocs économiques concurrents

segments.src: - Any calls to strengthen or reform the rules-based trading system
segments.tr: - Tout appel à renforcer ou à réformer le système commercial fondé sur des règles

segments.src: Because the outlook depends partly on policy decisions that can change quickly, forecasts in this area carry a high degree of uncertainty.
segments.tr: Parce que les perspectives dépendent en partie de décisions politiques qui peuvent changer rapidement, les prévisions dans ce domaine comportent un degré élevé d'incertitude.

segments.src: Treat precise numbers as estimates, not predictions.
segments.tr: Traitez les chiffres précis comme des estimations, pas comme des prédictions.

segments.src: ## Energy Costs and Conflict
segments.tr: ## Coûts de l'énergie et conflits

segments.src: Energy markets remain sensitive to geopolitical events.
segments.tr: Les marchés de l'énergie restent sensibles aux événements géopolitiques.

segments.src: Higher fuel and power costs weigh on households and firms, and they hit importing countries hardest.
segments.tr: La hausse des coûts du carburant et de l'électricité pèse sur les ménages et les entreprises, et frappe le plus durement les pays importateurs.

segments.src: The meetings may highlight how energy prices feed into inflation, and how governments can protect vulnerable people without adding to fiscal strain, for example through targeted support instead of broad subsidies.
segments.tr: Les réunions pourraient souligner comment les prix de l'énergie alimentent l'inflation, et comment les gouvernements peuvent protéger les personnes vulnérables sans ajouter à la pression budgétaire, par exemple par le biais d'un soutien ciblé plutôt que de subventions généralisées.

segments.src: ## Debt and Development
segments.tr: ## Dette et développement

segments.src: Beyond the global outlook, the World Bank and IMF will use the meetings to discuss the position of lower-income and developing countries.
segments.tr: Au-delà des perspectives mondiales, la Banque mondiale et le FMI utiliseront les réunions pour discuter de la situation des pays à faible revenu et en développement.

segments.src: Themes likely to come up include:
segments.tr: Les thèmes susceptibles d'être abordés incluent :

segments.src: - **Debt restructuring.** Progress, or the lack of it, in the multilateral frameworks used to restructure unsustainable debts, and how quickly agreements are reached.
segments.tr: - **Restructuration de la dette.** Les progrès, ou leur absence, dans les cadres multilatéraux utilisés pour restructurer les dettes non viables, et la rapidité avec laquelle les accords sont conclus.

segments.src: - **Financing for development.** How to mobilize more money for health, education, energy access and climate resilience when public budgets are stretched.
segments.tr: - **Financement du développement.** Comment mobiliser plus d'argent pour la santé, l'éducation, l'accès à l'énergie et la résilience climatique lorsque les budgets publics sont tendus.

segments.src: - **Role of private capital.** Whether guarantees, concessional loans and other tools can attract more private investment into developing economies.
segments.tr: - **Rôle du capital privé.** Si les garanties, les prêts concessionnels et d'autres outils peuvent attirer davantage d'investissements privés dans les économies en développement.

segments.src: - **Institutional reform.** Ongoing discussions about the lending capacity, governance and priorities of the institutions themselves.
segments.tr: - **Réforme institutionnelle.** Discussions en cours sur la capacité de prêt, la gouvernance et les priorités des institutions elles-mêmes.

segments.src: For many countries, the cost of servicing debt competes directly with spending on schools and hospitals.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux pays, le coût du service de la dette entre directement en concurrence avec les dépenses consacrées aux écoles et aux hôpitaux.

segments.src: Announcements that ease that trade-off, even modestly, can matter a great deal for the people affected.
segments.tr: Les annonces qui atténuent ce compromis, même modestement, peuvent avoir une grande importance pour les personnes concernées.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Coverage
segments.tr: ## Comment lire la couverture médiatique

segments.src: A few habits help when the headlines arrive:
segments.tr: Quelques habitudes sont utiles lorsque les gros titres arrivent :

segments.src: 1. **Read beyond the headline number.** Revisions of a few tenths of a percentage point are common and can reflect technical updates.
segments.tr: 1. **Lisez au-delà du chiffre principal.** Les révisions de quelques dixièmes de point de pourcentage sont courantes et peuvent refléter des mises à jour techniques.

segments.src: 2. **Check the assumptions.** Forecasts rest on assumptions about policy, energy prices and financial conditions. If these change, the outlook can too.
segments.tr: 2. **Vérifiez les hypothèses.** Les prévisions reposent sur des hypothèses concernant la politique, les prix de l'énergie et les conditions financières. Si celles-ci changent, les perspectives peuvent changer aussi.

segments.src: 3. **Separate signal from ceremony.** Communiqués are negotiated documents, and cautious wording often reflects compromise among many members.
segments.tr: 3. **Séparez le signal de la cérémonie.** Les communiqués sont des documents négociés, et un libellé prudent reflète souvent un compromis entre de nombreux membres.

segments.src: 4. **Look for follow-through.** The meaningful test is whether commitments made in Bangkok turn into concrete action in the following months.
segments.tr: 4. **Recherchez le suivi.** Le test significatif est de savoir si les engagements pris à Bangkok se transforment en actions concrètes dans les mois suivants.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: The Bangkok meetings are unlikely to resolve the pressures facing the world economy, but they will offer a useful snapshot of how the main global institutions see the road ahead.
segments.tr: Il est peu probable que les réunions de Bangkok résolvent les pressions auxquelles l'économie mondiale est confrontée, mais elles offriront un aperçu utile de la façon dont les principales institutions mondiales perçoivent la voie à suivre.

segments.src: The most informative signals will probably be the IMF's description of risks, its guidance on public finances and inflation, and any real movement on debt relief and development financing.
segments.tr: Les signaux les plus informatifs seront probablement la description des risques par le FMI, ses conseils sur les finances publiques et l'inflation, ainsi que tout mouvement réel sur l'allégement de la dette et le financement du développement.

segments.src: Readers should treat the outcomes as one input among many, and remember that forecasts are best understood as informed estimates in an uncertain environment.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs devraient traiter les résultats comme une donnée parmi d'autres, et se rappeler que les prévisions sont mieux comprises comme des estimations éclairées dans un environnement incertain.

segments.src: ## Why These Meetings Matter
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Pertemuan Ini Penting

segments.src: The Annual Meetings bring together officials from nearly all of the institutions' member countries.
segments.tr: Pertemuan Tahunan mempertemukan para pejabat dari hampir seluruh negara anggota institusi tersebut.

segments.src: Their value lies elsewhere:

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the IMF's Outlook
segments.tr: ## Hal yang Perlu Diperhatikan dalam Prospek IMF

segments.src: The IMF's World Economic Outlook is typically released around the meetings.
segments.tr: Prospek Ekonomi Global (World Economic Outlook) IMF biasanya dirilis di sekitar waktu pertemuan tersebut.

segments.src: Several questions are worth keeping in mind when it appears.
segments.tr: Beberapa pertanyaan layak untuk diingat saat laporan itu muncul.

segments.src: ### 1. Direction of the growth forecast
segments.tr: ### 1. Arah perkiraan pertumbuhan

segments.src: Look at whether global growth projections are revised up, down or left broadly unchanged compared with earlier editions.
segments.tr: Perhatikan apakah proyeksi pertumbuhan global direvisi naik, turun, atau dibiarkan relatif tidak berubah dibandingkan edisi sebelumnya.

segments.src: Small changes are common and are often less important than the explanation attached to them.
segments.tr: Perubahan kecil adalah hal yang biasa dan sering kali kurang penting dibandingkan penjelasan yang menyertainya.

segments.src: A forecast held steady because risks are balanced is different from one held steady despite growing concern.
segments.tr: Perkiraan yang dipertahankan tetap karena risiko yang seimbang berbeda dari perkiraan yang dipertahankan tetap meskipun ada kekhawatiran yang semakin besar.

segments.src: ### 2. The balance of risks
segments.tr: ### 2. Keseimbangan risiko

segments.src: The IMF usually describes risks as tilted to the downside, the upside or roughly balanced.
segments.tr: IMF biasanya mendeskripsikan risiko condong ke bawah (downside), ke atas (upside), atau kurang lebih seimbang.

segments.src: Pay attention to which factors it names.
segments.tr: Perhatikan faktor apa saja yang disebutkan.

segments.src: Frequently cited candidates include:
segments.tr: Kandidat yang sering dikutip meliputi:

segments.src: - Persistently high long-term government bond yields

segments.src: - Tightening or volatile financial conditions
segments.tr: - Pengetatan atau volatilitas kondisi keuangan

segments.src: ### 3. Inflation and interest rates
segments.tr: ### 3. Inflasi dan suku bunga

segments.src: Whether inflation is cooling toward central bank targets affects how quickly borrowing costs might ease.
segments.tr: Apakah inflasi mereda menuju target bank sentral memengaruhi seberapa cepat biaya pinjaman dapat melonggar.

segments.src: The IMF's commentary on the pace of disinflation, and on how far central banks should go in adjusting policy, is often one of the most closely read parts of the report.
segments.tr: Komentar IMF mengenai laju disinflasi, dan seberapa jauh bank sentral harus melangkah dalam menyesuaikan kebijakan, sering kali menjadi salah satu bagian laporan yang paling banyak dibaca secara cermat.

segments.src: ### 4. Differences between regions
segments.tr: ### 4. Perbedaan antarwilayah

segments.src: Advanced economies, emerging markets and low-income countries often face very different conditions.
segments.tr: Ekonomi maju, pasar berkembang, dan negara berpendapatan rendah sering kali menghadapi kondisi yang sangat berbeda.

segments.src: Watch for how the report treats Asia, which is hosting the meetings, as well as energy-importing economies that are more exposed to price shocks.
segments.tr: Perhatikan bagaimana laporan tersebut memperlakukan Asia, yang menjadi tuan rumah pertemuan, serta ekonomi pengimpor energi yang lebih rentan terhadap kejutan harga.

segments.src: ## The Bond Yield Question
segments.tr: ## Pertanyaan Mengenai Imbal Hasil Obligasi

segments.src: High yields on government debt matter well beyond bond traders.
segments.tr: Imbal hasil yang tinggi pada utang pemerintah sangat penting di luar para trader obligasi.

segments.src: When governments pay more to borrow, interest costs take up a larger share of budgets, leaving less room for spending on public services, infrastructure or support during downturns.
segments.tr: Ketika pemerintah membayar lebih untuk meminjam, biaya bunga menyerap porsi yang lebih besar dari anggaran, menyisakan lebih sedikit ruang untuk pengeluaran layanan publik, infrastruktur, atau dukungan selama kelesuan ekonomi.

segments.src: Higher yields can also spill over into mortgage rates, corporate borrowing and the exchange rates of other countries.
segments.tr: Imbal hasil yang lebih tinggi juga dapat merembet ke suku bunga KPR, pinjaman perusahaan, dan nilai tukar negara lain.

segments.src: At the meetings, expect discussion of fiscal sustainability: how governments can put public finances on a steadier path without choking off growth.
segments.tr: Pada pertemuan tersebut, perhatikan diskusi mengenai kesinambungan fiskal: bagaimana pemerintah dapat menempatkan keuangan publik pada jalur yang lebih stabil tanpa mencekik pertumbuhan.

segments.src: The IMF has long encouraged credible medium-term plans, and the language it uses on this topic can hint at how urgent it considers the issue.
segments.tr: IMF telah lama mendorong rencana jangka menengah yang kredibel, dan bahasa yang digunakannya mengenai topik ini dapat mengisyaratkan seberapa mendesak isu tersebut menurut pandangan mereka.

segments.src: ## Trade Friction
segments.tr: ## Gesekan Perdagangan

segments.src: Trade tensions are likely to feature in both formal sessions and informal conversations.
segments.tr: Ketegangan perdagangan kemungkinan besar akan ditampilkan dalam sesi formal maupun percakapan informal.

segments.src: Key points to follow include:
segments.tr: Poin-poin penting yang perlu diikuti meliputi:

segments.src: - Whether the IMF quantifies the effect of trade barriers on growth and prices
segments.tr: - Apakah IMF mengkuantifikasi efek hambatan perdagangan terhadap pertumbuhan dan harga

segments.src: - How officials describe the risk of fragmentation into competing economic blocs
segments.tr: - Bagaimana para pejabat mendeskripsikan risiko fragmentasi menjadi blok-blok ekonomi yang bersaing

segments.src: - Any calls to strengthen or reform the rules-based trading system
segments.tr: - Setiap seruan untuk memperkuat atau mereformasi sistem perdagangan berbasis aturan

segments.src: Because the outlook depends partly on policy decisions that can change quickly, forecasts in this area carry a high degree of uncertainty.
segments.tr: Karena prospek bergantung sebagian pada keputusan kebijakan yang dapat berubah dengan cepat, perkiraan di bidang ini membawa tingkat ketidakpastian yang tinggi.

segments.src: Treat precise numbers as estimates, not predictions.
segments.tr: Perlakukan angka-angka yang tepat sebagai estimasi, bukan prediksi.

segments.src: ## Energy Costs and Conflict
segments.tr: ## Biaya Energi dan Konflik

segments.src: Energy markets remain sensitive to geopolitical events.
segments.tr: Pasar energi tetap sensitif terhadap peristiwa geopolitik.

segments.src: Higher fuel and power costs weigh on households and firms, and they hit importing countries hardest.
segments.tr: Biaya bahan bakar dan listrik yang lebih tinggi membebani rumah tangga dan perusahaan, dan dampaknya paling parah menimpa negara-negara pengimpor.

segments.src: The meetings may highlight how energy prices feed into inflation, and how governments can protect vulnerable people without adding to fiscal strain, for example through targeted support instead of broad subsidies.
segments.tr: Pertemuan tersebut dapat menyoroti bagaimana harga energi masuk ke dalam inflasi, dan bagaimana pemerintah dapat melindungi kelompok rentan tanpa menambah tekanan fiskal, misalnya melalui dukungan yang tepat sasaran alih-alih subsidi yang luas.

segments.src: ## Debt and Development
segments.tr: ## Utang dan Pembangunan

segments.src: Beyond the global outlook, the World Bank and IMF will use the meetings to discuss the position of lower-income and developing countries.
segments.tr: Di luar prospek global, Bank Dunia dan IMF akan menggunakan pertemuan tersebut untuk mendiskusikan posisi negara-negara berpendapatan rendah dan berkembang.

segments.src: Themes likely to come up include:
segments.tr: Tema yang kemungkinan besar akan muncul meliputi:

segments.src: - **Debt restructuring.** Progress, or the lack of it, in the multilateral frameworks used to restructure unsustainable debts, and how quickly agreements are reached.
segments.tr: - **Restrukturisasi utang.** Kemajuan, atau ketiadaannya, dalam kerangka kerja multilateral yang digunakan untuk merestrukturisasi utang yang tidak berkelanjutan, dan seberapa cepat kesepakatan tercapai.

segments.src: - **Financing for development.** How to mobilize more money for health, education, energy access and climate resilience when public budgets are stretched.
segments.tr: - **Pembiayaan untuk pembangunan.** Bagaimana memobilisasi lebih banyak dana untuk kesehatan, pendidikan, akses energi, dan ketahanan iklim ketika anggaran publik sedang tertekan.

segments.src: - **Role of private capital.** Whether guarantees, concessional loans and other tools can attract more private investment into developing economies.
segments.tr: - **Peran modal swasta.** Apakah jaminan, pinjaman lunak, dan alat lainnya dapat menarik lebih banyak investasi swasta ke dalam ekonomi berkembang.

segments.src: - **Institutional reform.** Ongoing discussions about the lending capacity, governance and priorities of the institutions themselves.
segments.tr: - **Reformasi kelembagaan.** Diskusi yang sedang berlangsung mengenai kapasitas pinjaman, tata kelola, dan prioritas dari lembaga-lembaga itu sendiri.

segments.src: For many countries, the cost of servicing debt competes directly with spending on schools and hospitals.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak negara, biaya untuk melayani utang bersaing secara langsung dengan pengeluaran untuk sekolah dan rumah sakit.

segments.src: Announcements that ease that trade-off, even modestly, can matter a great deal for the people affected.
segments.tr: Pengumuman yang meringankan pertukaran tersebut, bahkan secara sederhana, dapat sangat berarti bagi orang-orang yang terkena dampaknya.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Coverage
segments.tr: ## Cara Membaca Pemberitaan

segments.src: A few habits help when the headlines arrive:
segments.tr: Beberapa kebiasaan membantu saat berita utama tiba:

segments.src: 1. **Read beyond the headline number.** Revisions of a few tenths of a percentage point are common and can reflect technical updates.
segments.tr: 1. **Baca melampaui angka utama.** Revisi beberapa persepuluh persen adalah hal yang biasa dan dapat mencerminkan pembaruan teknis.

segments.src: 2. **Check the assumptions.** Forecasts rest on assumptions about policy, energy prices and financial conditions. If these change, the outlook can too.
segments.tr: 2. **Periksa asumsi.** Perkiraan didasarkan pada asumsi tentang kebijakan, harga energi, dan kondisi keuangan. Jika ini berubah, prospeknya juga bisa berubah.

segments.src: 3. **Separate signal from ceremony.** Communiqués are negotiated documents, and cautious wording often reflects compromise among many members.
segments.tr: 3. **Pisahkan sinyal dari seremoni.** Komunike adalah dokumen yang dinegosiasikan, dan bahasa yang hati-hati sering kali mencerminkan kompromi di antara banyak anggota.

segments.src: 4. **Look for follow-through.** The meaningful test is whether commitments made in Bangkok turn into concrete action in the following months.
segments.tr: 4. **Cari tindak lanjut.** Ujian yang berarti adalah apakah komitmen yang dibuat di Bangkok berubah menjadi tindakan nyata di bulan-bulan berikutnya.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The Bangkok meetings are unlikely to resolve the pressures facing the world economy, but they will offer a useful snapshot of how the main global institutions see the road ahead.
segments.tr: Pertemuan di Bangkok tidak mungkin menyelesaikan tekanan yang dihadapi ekonomi global, tetapi pertemuan tersebut akan menawarkan gambaran yang berguna tentang bagaimana institusi global utama melihat jalan ke depan.

segments.src: The most informative signals will probably be the IMF's description of risks, its guidance on public finances and inflation, and any real movement on debt relief and development financing.
segments.tr: Sinyal yang paling informatif mungkin adalah deskripsi IMF tentang risiko, panduannya mengenai keuangan publik dan inflasi, serta setiap pergerakan nyata pada keringanan utang dan pembiayaan pembangunan.

segments.src: Readers should treat the outcomes as one input among many, and remember that forecasts are best understood as informed estimates in an uncertain environment.
segments.tr: Pembaca harus memperlakukan hasil tersebut sebagai salah satu masukan di antara banyak masukan, dan ingat bahwa perkiraan paling baik dipahami sebagai estimasi yang berdasar dalam lingkungan yang tidak pasti.

ja.title: バンコク開催の呼びかけ：IMF・世界銀行年次総会が脆弱な世界経済について示唆するもの

segments.src: Finance ministers, central bankers and development officials are set to gather in Bangkok in mid-October for the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group.
segments.tr: 財務相、中央銀行総裁、開発当局者らは10月中旬、国際通貨基金（IMF）と世界銀行グループの年次総会のためにバンコクに参集する予定である。

segments.src: The setting is a familiar one: a week of speeches, closed-door sessions and policy communiqués.
segments.tr: その舞台は、数日間にわたる演説、非公開セッション、政策共同声明という見慣れたものである。

segments.src: The backdrop is less familiar.
segments.tr: しかし、その背景は見慣れないものになりつつある。

segments.src: Borrowing costs remain elevated in many markets, trade relationships are under strain, and conflict-related disruptions continue to influence energy prices.
segments.tr: 多くの市場で借入コストが高止まりし、貿易関係は緊張にさらされ、紛争に関連した混乱がエネルギー価格に影響を与え続けている。

segments.src: Together, these pressures shape how policymakers think about growth in the year ahead.
segments.tr: こうしたプレッシャーが合わさることで、政策立案者が来年の成長をどのように捉えるかが形作られている。

segments.src: This guide explains what the meetings are, which themes are likely to matter, and how to read the headlines without over-interpreting them.
segments.tr: このガイドでは、総会とは何か、どのようなテーマが重要になりそうか、そして見出しを過度に解釈せずに読み解く方法について説明する。

segments.src: ## Why These Meetings Matter
segments.tr: ## なぜこれらの総会が重要なのか

segments.src: The Annual Meetings bring together officials from nearly all of the institutions' member countries.
segments.tr: 年次総会には、これらの機関のほぼすべての加盟国の当局者が集まる。

segments.src: They are not a place where binding decisions on the world economy are made in a single stroke.
segments.tr: 総会は、世界経済に関する拘束力のある決定が一挙になされる場ではない。

segments.src: Their value lies elsewhere:
segments.tr: その価値は別のところにある。

segments.src: - **Shared assessments.** The IMF publishes updated forecasts and risk assessments that governments, businesses and analysts use as a common reference point.
segments.tr: - **共通の評価。** IMFは、政府、企業、アナリストが共通の基準点として使用する最新の予測とリスク評価を発表する。

segments.src: - **Coordination.** Officials meet bilaterally on the sidelines, which can move stalled negotiations forward, including those on debt.
segments.tr: - **協調。** 当局者らは会議の合間に二国間で会談し、債務問題など膠着した交渉を前進させることができる。

segments.src: - **Signaling.** The tone of communiqués and press conferences can indicate how officials weigh risks such as inflation, slower growth and financial stability.
segments.tr: - **シグナル発信。** 共同声明や記者会見のトーンは、当局者がインフレ、成長の鈍化、金融安定といったリスクをどのように評価しているかを示唆するものとなる。

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the IMF's Outlook
segments.tr: ## IMFの見通しで注目すべき点

segments.src: The IMF's World Economic Outlook is typically released around the meetings.
segments.tr: IMFの世界経済見通し（World Economic Outlook）は通常、総会の時期に合わせて発表される。

segments.src: Several questions are worth keeping in mind when it appears.
segments.tr: 発表された際には、いくつかの疑問を念頭に置いておく価値がある。

segments.src: ### 1. Direction of the growth forecast
segments.tr: ### 1. 成長予測の方向性

segments.src: Look at whether global growth projections are revised up, down or left broadly unchanged compared with earlier editions.
segments.tr: 世界経済の成長予測が、以前の版と比較して上方修正されたか、下方修正されたか、あるいは概ね据え置かれたかに注目する。

segments.src: Small changes are common and are often less important than the explanation attached to them.
segments.tr: 小幅な修正はよくあることであり、多くの場合、それに付随する説明ほど重要ではない。

segments.src: A forecast held steady because risks are balanced is different from one held steady despite growing concern.
segments.tr: リスクが均衡しているために据え置かれた予測は、高まる懸念にもかかわらず据え置かれた予測とは異なる。

segments.src: ### 2. The balance of risks
segments.tr: ### 2. リスクのバランス

segments.src: The IMF usually describes risks as tilted to the downside, the upside or roughly balanced.
segments.tr: IMFは通常、リスクを下振れリスク、上振れリスク、あるいはほぼ均衡していると表現する。

segments.src: Pay attention to which factors it names.
segments.tr: どのような要因が挙げられているかに注目すること。

segments.src: Frequently cited candidates include:
segments.tr: 頻繁に挙げられる候補には以下が含まれる。

segments.src: - Persistently high long-term government bond yields
segments.tr: - 持続的な長期国債利回りの高止まり

segments.src: - Trade restrictions and uncertainty about tariffs
segments.tr: - 貿易制限と関税に関する不確実性

segments.src: - Energy price swings linked to ongoing conflicts
segments.tr: - 継続中の紛争に関連するエネルギー価格の変動

segments.src: - Tightening or volatile financial conditions
segments.tr: - 引き締め的または不安定な金融環境

segments.src: ### 3. Inflation and interest rates
segments.tr: ### 3. インフレと金利

segments.src: Whether inflation is cooling toward central bank targets affects how quickly borrowing costs might ease.
segments.tr: インフレ率が中央銀行の目標に向けて鎮静化しているかどうかが、借入コスト緩和のペースに影響を与える。

segments.src: The IMF's commentary on the pace of disinflation, and on how far central banks should go in adjusting policy, is often one of the most closely read parts of the report.
segments.tr: ディスインフレのペースや、中央銀行が政策調整をどこまで進めるべきかに関するIMFの見解は、レポートの中で最も熟読される部分の1つであることが多い。

segments.src: ### 4. Differences between regions
segments.tr: ### 4. 地域間の違い

segments.src: Advanced economies, emerging markets and low-income countries often face very different conditions.
segments.tr: 先進国、新興市場国、低所得国は、しばしば非常に異なる状況に直面している。

segments.src: Watch for how the report treats Asia, which is hosting the meetings, as well as energy-importing economies that are more exposed to price shocks.
segments.tr: レポートが、総会の開催地であるアジアや、価格ショックにより影響を受けやすいエネルギー輸入国をどのように扱っているかに注目したい。

segments.src: ## The Bond Yield Question
segments.tr: ## 国債利回りの問題

segments.src: High yields on government debt matter well beyond bond traders.
segments.tr: 政府債務の高利回りは、債券トレーダーをはるかに超えた影響を持つ。

segments.src: When governments pay more to borrow, interest costs take up a larger share of budgets, leaving less room for spending on public services, infrastructure or support during downturns.
segments.tr: 政府の借入コストが増加すると、利払費が予算のより大きな割合を占めることになり、公共サービス、インフラ、あるいは景気低迷時の支援への支出の余地が狭まる。

segments.src: Higher yields can also spill over into mortgage rates, corporate borrowing and the exchange rates of other countries.
segments.tr: また、利回りの上昇は、住宅ローン金利、企業の借入、そして他国の為替レートにも波及する可能性がある。

segments.src: At the meetings, expect discussion of fiscal sustainability: how governments can put public finances on a steadier path without choking off growth.
segments.tr: 総会では、財政の持続可能性についての議論が予想される。すなわち、成長を損なうことなく、政府がどのように公的財政をより安定した軌道に乗せることができるかという点である。

segments.src: The IMF has long encouraged credible medium-term plans, and the language it uses on this topic can hint at how urgent it considers the issue.
segments.tr: IMFは長年にわたり信頼性のある中期計画を奨励してきおり、このトピックで使用される言葉は、IMFがこの問題をどれほど緊急性の高いものと見なしているかを示唆することがある。

segments.src: ## Trade Friction
segments.tr: ## 貿易摩擦

segments.src: Trade tensions are likely to feature in both formal sessions and informal conversations.
segments.tr: 貿易摩擦は、公式セッションと非公式の会話の両方で取り上げられる可能性が高い。

segments.src: Key points to follow include:
segments.tr: フォローすべき重要なポイントには以下が含まれる。

segments.src: - Whether the IMF quantifies the effect of trade barriers on growth and prices
segments.tr: - IMFが成長と物価に対する貿易障壁の影響を定量化しているかどうか

segments.src: - How officials describe the risk of fragmentation into competing economic blocs
segments.tr: - 競合する経済圏への分裂リスクを当局者がどのように表現しているか

segments.src: - Any calls to strengthen or reform the rules-based trading system
segments.tr: - ルールに基づく貿易体制の強化または改革を求める声の有無

segments.src: Because the outlook depends partly on policy decisions that can change quickly, forecasts in this area carry a high degree of uncertainty.
segments.tr: 見通しは急速に変わり得る政策決定に部分的に依存しているため、この分野の予測には高い不確実性が伴う。

segments.src: Treat precise numbers as estimates, not predictions.
segments.tr: 正確な数値は予測ではなく、あくまで見積もりとして扱うこと。

segments.src: ## Energy Costs and Conflict
segments.tr: ## エネルギーコストと紛争

segments.src: Energy markets remain sensitive to geopolitical events.
segments.tr: エネルギー市場は地政学的イベントに対して敏感なままである。

segments.src: Higher fuel and power costs weigh on households and firms, and they hit importing countries hardest.
segments.tr: 燃料費や電力費の高騰は家計や企業を圧迫し、輸入国に最も深刻な打撃を与える。

segments.src: The meetings may highlight how energy prices feed into inflation, and how governments can protect vulnerable people without adding to fiscal strain, for example through targeted support instead of broad subsidies.
segments.tr: 総会では、エネルギー価格がどのようにインフレに波及するか、また、広範な補助金ではなく対象を絞った支援などを通じて、政府が財政負担を増大させることなくどのように脆弱な人々を保護できるかが強調される可能性がある。

segments.src: ## Debt and Development
segments.tr: ## 債務と開発

segments.src: Beyond the global outlook, the World Bank and IMF will use the meetings to discuss the position of lower-income and developing countries.
segments.tr: 世界経済の見通しを超えて、世界銀行とIMFは総会を利用して、低所得国および途上国の立場について議論する。

segments.src: Themes likely to come up include:
segments.tr: 取り上げられる可能性の高いテーマには以下が含まれる。

segments.src: - **Debt restructuring.** Progress, or the lack of it, in the multilateral frameworks used to restructure unsustainable debts, and how quickly agreements are reached.
segments.tr: - **債務再編。** 持続不可能な債務を再編するために使用される多国間枠組みにおける進展（あるいはその欠如）、および合意に達するスピード。

segments.src: - **Financing for development.** How to mobilize more money for health, education, energy access and climate resilience when public budgets are stretched.
segments.tr: - **開発のための資金調達。** 公共財政が逼迫している状況下で、健康、教育、エネルギーアクセス、気候変動に対するレジリエンスのために、いかに多くの資金を動員するか。

segments.src: - **Role of private capital.** Whether guarantees, concessional loans and other tools can attract more private investment into developing economies.
segments.tr: - **民間資本の役割。** 保証、譲許的融資、その他のツールが、途上国へのより多くの民間投資を引き付けることができるか。

segments.src: - **Institutional reform.** Ongoing discussions about the lending capacity, governance and priorities of the institutions themselves.
segments.tr: - **制度改革。** 機関自体の融資能力、ガバナンス、優先事項に関する継続的な議論。

segments.src: For many countries, the cost of servicing debt competes directly with spending on schools and hospitals.
segments.tr: 多くの国にとって、債務返済のコストは学校や病院への支出と直接競合している。

segments.src: Announcements that ease that trade-off, even modestly, can matter a great deal for the people affected.
segments.tr: たとえささやかなものであっても、そのトレードオフを緩和する発表は、影響を受ける人々にとって極めて重要となり得る。

segments.src: ## How to Read the Coverage
segments.tr: ## 報道の読み方

segments.src: A few habits help when the headlines arrive:
segments.tr: 見出しが出たときには、いくつかの習慣が役立つ。

de.title: Bangkok Calling: Was die Jahrestagungen von IWF und Weltbank über eine fragile Weltwirtschaft signalisieren könnten

segments.src: Finance ministers, central bankers and development officials are set to gather in Bangkok in mid-October for the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group.
segments.tr: Finanzminister, Zentralbanker und Entwicklungspolitiker werden Mitte Oktober in Bangkok zu den Jahrestagungen des Internationalen Währungsfonds (IWF) und der Weltbankgruppe zusammenkommen.

segments.src: The setting is a familiar one: a week of speeches, closed-door sessions and policy communiqués.
segments.tr: Der Rahmen ist vertraut: eine Woche voller Reden, nicht öffentlicher Sitzungen und politischer Kommuniqués.

segments.src: The backdrop is less familiar.
segments.tr: Der Hintergrund ist weniger vertraut.

segments.src: Borrowing costs remain elevated in many markets, trade relationships are under strain, and conflict-related disruptions continue to influence energy prices.
segments.tr: Die Kreditkosten bleiben in vielen Märkten hoch, die Handelsbeziehungen stehen unter Druck, und konfliktbedingte Störungen beeinflussen weiterhin die Energiepreise.

segments.src: Together, these pressures shape how policymakers think about growth in the year ahead.
segments.tr: Zusammen bestimmen diese Belastungen, wie politische Entscheidungsträger über das Wachstum im kommenden Jahr denken.

segments.src: This guide explains what the meetings are, which themes are likely to matter, and how to read the headlines without over-interpreting them.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden erklärt, was die Tagungen sind, welche Themen voraussichtlich wichtig sein werden und wie man die Schlagzeilen liest, ohne sie zu überinterpretieren.

segments.src: ## Why These Meetings Matter
segments.tr: ## Warum diese Tagungen wichtig sind

segments.src: The Annual Meetings bring together officials from nearly all of the institutions' member countries.
segments.tr: Die Jahrestagungen bringen Beamte aus fast allen Mitgliedsländern der Institutionen zusammen.

segments.src: They are not a place where binding decisions on the world economy are made in a single stroke.
segments.tr: Sie sind kein Ort, an dem bindende Entscheidungen über die Weltwirtschaft in einem einzigen Schritt getroffen werden.

segments.src: Their value lies elsewhere:
segments.tr: Ihr Wert liegt woanders:

segments.src: - **Shared assessments.** The IMF publishes updated forecasts and risk assessments that governments, businesses and analysts use as a common reference point.
segments.tr: - **Geteilte Einschätzungen.** Der IWF veröffentlicht aktualisierte Prognosen und Risikobewertungen, die Regierungen, Unternehmen und Analysten als gemeinsamen Bezugspunkt nutzen.

segments.src: - **Coordination.** Officials meet bilaterally on the sidelines, which can move stalled negotiations forward, including those on debt.
segments.tr: - **Koordinierung.** Beamte treffen sich bilateral am Rande, was ins Stocken geratene Verhandlungen voranbringen kann, einschließlich derjenigen über Schulden.

segments.src: - **Signaling.** The tone of communiqués and press conferences can indicate how officials weigh risks such as inflation, slower growth and financial stability.
segments.tr: - **Signalwirkung.** Der Ton von Kommuniqués und Pressekonferenzen kann zeigen, wie Beamte Risiken wie Inflation, langsameres Wachstum und Finanzstabilität abwägen.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the IMF's Outlook
segments.tr: ## Worauf beim IWF-Ausblick zu achten ist

segments.src: The IMF's World Economic Outlook is typically released around the meetings.
segments.tr: Der Weltwirtschaftsausblick des IWF wird in der Regel um die Tagungen herum veröffentlicht.

segments.src: Several questions are worth keeping in mind when it appears.
segments.tr: Mehrere Fragen sollte man im Hinterkopf behalten, wenn er erscheint.

segments.src: ### 1. Direction of the growth forecast
segments.tr: ### 1. Richtung der Wachstumsprognose

segments.src: Look at whether global growth projections are revised up, down or left broadly unchanged compared with earlier editions.
segments.tr: Achten Sie darauf, ob die globalen Wachstumsprognosen im Vergleich zu früheren Ausgaben nach oben oder unten korrigiert oder im Wesentlichen unverändert gelassen werden.

segments.src: Small changes are common and are often less important than the explanation attached to them.
segments.tr: Kleine Änderungen sind üblich und oft weniger wichtig als die damit verbundene Erklärung.

segments.src: A forecast held steady because risks are balanced is different from one held steady despite growing concern.
segments.tr: Eine Prognose, die stabil gehalten wird, weil die Risiken ausgewogen sind, unterscheidet sich von einer, die trotz wachsender Sorge stabil gehalten wird.

segments.src: ### 2. The balance of risks
segments.tr: ### 2. Die Risikoverteilung

segments.src: The IMF usually describes risks as tilted to the downside, the upside or roughly balanced.
segments.tr: Der IWF beschreibt Risiken normalerweise als abwärtsgerichtet, aufwärtsgerichtet oder etwa ausgewogen.

segments.src: Pay attention to which factors it names.
segments.tr: Achten Sie darauf, welche Faktoren er nennt.

segments.src: Frequently cited candidates include:
segments.tr: Häufig genannte Kandidaten sind:

segments.src: - Persistently high long-term government bond yields
segments.tr: - Anhaltend hohe langfristige Staatsanleiherenditen

segments.src: - Trade restrictions and uncertainty about tariffs
segments.tr: - Handelsbeschränkungen und Unsicherheit über Zölle

segments.src: - Energy price swings linked to ongoing conflicts
segments.tr: - Schwankungen der Energiepreise im Zusammenhang mit anhaltenden Konflikten

segments.src: - Tightening or volatile financial conditions
segments.tr: - Straffere oder volatile Finanzierungsbedingungen

segments.src: ### 3. Inflation and interest rates
segments.tr: ### 3. Inflation und Zinssätze

segments.src: Whether inflation is cooling toward central bank targets affects how quickly borrowing costs might ease.
segments.tr: Ob sich die Inflation den Zielvorgaben der Zentralbanken annähert, beeinflusst, wie schnell die Kreditkosten sinken könnten.

segments.src: The IMF's commentary on the pace of disinflation, and on how far central banks should go in adjusting policy, is often one of the most closely read parts of the report.
segments.tr: Der Kommentar des IWF zum Tempo der Disinflation und dazu, wie weit die Zentralbanken bei der Anpassung der Politik gehen sollten, ist oft einer der am aufmerksamsten gelesenen Teile des Berichts.

segments.src: ### 4. Differences between regions
segments.tr: ### 4. Unterschiede zwischen den Regionen

segments.src: Advanced economies, emerging markets and low-income countries often face very different conditions.
segments.tr: Industrienationen, Schwellenländer und Länder mit niedrigem Einkommen sehen sich oft sehr unterschiedlichen Bedingungen gegenüber.

segments.src: Watch for how the report treats Asia, which is hosting the meetings, as well as energy-importing economies that are more exposed to price shocks.
segments.tr: Achten Sie darauf, wie der Bericht Asien behandelt, das die Tagungen ausrichtet, sowie energieimportierende Volkswirtschaften, die anfälliger für Preisschocks sind.

segments.src: ## The Bond Yield Question
segments.tr: ## Die Frage der Anleiherenditen

segments.src: High yields on government debt matter well beyond bond traders.
segments.tr: Hohe Renditen auf Staatsschulden sind weit über den Kreis der Anleihehändler hinaus von Bedeutung.

segments.src: When governments pay more to borrow, interest costs take up a larger share of budgets, leaving less room for spending on public services, infrastructure or support during downturns.
segments.tr: Wenn Regierungen mehr für Kredite zahlen, beanspruchen die Zinskosten einen größeren Teil des Budgets, wodurch weniger Spielraum für Ausgaben für öffentliche Dienstleistungen, Infrastruktur oder Unterstützung in Abschwungphasen bleibt.

segments.src: Higher yields can also spill over into mortgage rates, corporate borrowing and the exchange rates of other countries.
segments.tr: Höhere Renditen können auch auf Hypothekenzinsen, Unternehmensanleihen und die Wechselkurse anderer Länder übergreifen.

segments.src: At the meetings, expect discussion of fiscal sustainability: how governments can put public finances on a steadier path without choking off growth.
segments.tr: Erwarten Sie auf den Tagungen Diskussionen über die Tragfähigkeit der öffentlichen Finanzen: wie Regierungen die öffentlichen Finanzen auf einen stabileren Pfad bringen können, ohne das Wachstum abzuwürgen.

segments.src: The IMF has long encouraged credible medium-term plans, and the language it uses on this topic can hint at how urgent it considers the issue.
segments.tr: Der IWF befürwortet seit langem glaubwürdige mittelfristige Pläne, und die Sprache, die er zu diesem Thema verwendet, kann darauf hindeuten, wie dringend er das Problem einschätzt.

segments.src: ## Trade Friction
segments.tr: ## Handelskonflikte

segments.src: Trade tensions are likely to feature in both formal sessions and informal conversations.
segments.tr: Handelsspannungen werden wahrscheinlich sowohl in formalen Sitzungen als auch in informellen Gesprächen eine Rolle spielen.

segments.src: Key points to follow include:
segments.tr: Wichtige Punkte, denen man folgen sollte, sind:

segments.src: - Whether the IMF quantifies the effect of trade barriers on growth and prices
segments.tr: - Ob der IWF die Auswirkungen von Handelsschranken auf Wachstum und Preise quantifiziert

segments.src: - How officials describe the risk of fragmentation into competing economic blocs
segments.tr: - Wie Beamte das Risiko einer Fragmentierung in konkurrierende Wirtschaftsblöcke beschreiben

segments.src: - Any calls to strengthen or reform the rules-based trading system
segments.tr: - Etwaige Aufrufe zur Stärkung oder Reform des regelbasierten Handelssystems

segments.src: Because the outlook depends partly on policy decisions that can change quickly, forecasts in this area carry a high degree of uncertainty.
segments.tr: Da der Ausblick teilweise von politischen Entscheidungen abhängt, die sich schnell ändern können, sind Prognosen in diesem Bereich mit einem hohen Maß an Unsicherheit verbunden.

segments.src: Treat precise numbers as estimates, not predictions.
segments.tr: Behandeln Sie genaue Zahlen als Schätzungen, nicht als Vorhersagen.

segments.src: ## Energy Costs and Conflict
segments.tr: ## Energiekosten und Konflikte

segments.src: Energy markets remain sensitive to geopolitical events.
segments.tr: Die Energiemärkte bleiben anfällig für geopolitische Ereignisse.

segments.src: Higher fuel and power costs weigh on households and firms, and they hit importing countries hardest.
segments.tr: Höhere Brennstoff- und Stromkosten belasten Haushalte und Unternehmen und treffen importierende Länder am härtesten.

segments.src: The meetings may highlight how energy prices feed into inflation, and how governments can protect vulnerable people without adding to fiscal strain, for example through targeted support instead of broad subsidies.
segments.tr: Die Tagungen könnten hervorheben, wie Energiepreise in die Inflation einfließen und wie Regierungen schutzbedürftige Menschen schützen können, ohne die Haushaltsbelastung zu erhöhen, beispielsweise durch gezielte Unterstützung statt breiter Subventionen.

segments.src: ## Debt and Development
segments.tr: ## Schulden und Entwicklung

segments.src: Beyond the global outlook, the World Bank and IMF will use the meetings to discuss the position of lower-income and developing countries.
segments.tr: Über den globalen Ausblick hinaus werden die Weltbank und der IWF die Tagungen nutzen, um die Situation von Ländern mit niedrigerem Einkommen und Entwicklungsländern zu erörtern.

segments.src: Themes likely to come up include:
segments.tr: Themen, die wahrscheinlich zur Sprache kommen werden, sind:

segments.src: - **Debt restructuring.** Progress, or the lack of it, in the multilateral frameworks used to restructure unsustainable debts, and how quickly agreements are reached.
segments.tr: - **Umschuldung.** Fortschritte oder deren Ausbleiben bei den multilateralen Rahmenwerken zur Umschuldung nicht tragfähiger Schulden und wie schnell Einigungen erzielt werden.

segments.src: - **Financing for development.** How to mobilize more money for health, education, energy access and climate resilience when public budgets are stretched.
segments.tr: - **Finanzierung für die Entwicklung.** Wie man mehr Geld für Gesundheit, Bildung, Energiezugang und Klimaresilienz mobilisieren kann, wenn die öffentlichen Haushalte angespannt sind.

segments.src: - **Role of private capital.** Whether guarantees, concessional loans and other tools can attract more private investment into developing economies.
segments.tr: - **Rolle des privaten Kapitals.** Ob Garantien, zinsgünstige Kredite und andere Instrumente mehr private Investitionen in Entwicklungsländer locken können.

segments.src: - **Institutional reform.** Ongoing discussions about the lending capacity, governance and priorities of the institutions themselves.
segments.tr: - **Institutionelle Reform.** Laufende Diskussionen über die Kreditvergabekapazität, die Führung und die Prioritäten der Institutionen selbst.

segments.src: For many countries, the cost of servicing debt competes directly with spending on schools and hospitals.
segments.tr: Für viele Länder konkurrieren die Kosten für den Schuldendienst direkt mit den Ausgaben für Schulen und Krankenhäuser.

segments.src: Announcements that ease that trade-off, even modestly, can matter a great deal for the people affected.
segments.tr: Ankündigungen, die diesen Zielkonflikt auch nur geringfügig abmildern, können für die betroffenen Menschen von großer Bedeutung sein.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Coverage
segments.tr: ## Wie man die Berichterstattung liest

segments.src: A few habits help when the headlines arrive:
segments.tr: Ein paar Gewohnheiten helfen, wenn die Schlagzeilen eintreffen:

segments.src: 1. **Read beyond the headline number.** Revisions of a few tenths of a percentage point are common and can reflect technical updates.
segments.tr: 1. **Lesen Sie über die Schlagzeilenzahl hinaus.** Revisionen von einigen Zehntelprozentpunkten sind üblich und können technische Aktualisierungen widerspiegeln.

segments.src: 2. **Check the assumptions.** Forecasts rest on assumptions about policy, energy prices and financial conditions. If these change, the outlook can too.
segments.tr: 2. **Überprüfen Sie die Annahmen.** Prognosen basieren auf Annahmen über Politik, Energiepreise und Finanzierungsbedingungen. Wenn sich diese ändern, kann sich auch der Ausblick ändern.

segments.src: 3. **Separate signal from ceremony.** Communiqués are negotiated documents, and cautious wording often reflects compromise among many members.
segments.tr: 3. **Trennen Sie Signal von Zeremonie.** Kommuniqués sind ausgehandelte Dokumente, und eine vorsichtige Wortwahl spiegelt oft den Kompromiss zwischen vielen Mitgliedern wider.

segments.src: 4. **Look for follow-through.** The meaningful test is whether commitments made in Bangkok turn into concrete action in the following months.
segments.tr: 4. **Achten Sie auf die Umsetzung.** Der aussagekräftige Test ist, ob in Bangkok eingegangene Verpflichtungen in den folgenden Monaten zu konkreten Maßnahmen werden.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: The Bangkok meetings are unlikely to resolve the pressures facing the world economy, but they will offer a useful snapshot of how the main global institutions see the road ahead.
segments.tr: Die Tagungen in Bangkok werden die Belastungen der Weltwirtschaft wahrscheinlich nicht lösen, aber sie werden eine nützliche Momentaufnahme davon liefern, wie die wichtigsten globalen Institutionen den kommenden Weg sehen.

segments.src: The most informative signals will probably be the IMF's description of risks, its guidance on public finances and inflation, and any real movement on debt relief and development financing.
segments.tr: Die informativsten Signale werden wahrscheinlich die Beschreibung der Risiken durch den IWF, seine Leitlinien zu öffentlichen Finanzen und Inflation sowie echte Fortschritte bei Schuldenerlass und Entwicklungsfinanzierung sein.

segments.src: Readers should treat the outcomes as one input among many, and remember that forecasts are best understood as informed estimates in an uncertain environment.
segments.tr: Leser sollten die Ergebnisse als einen Input unter vielen betrachten und sich daran erinnern, dass Prognosen am besten als fundierte Schätzungen in einem unsicheren Umfeld verstanden werden.

segments.tr: Những thay đổi nhỏ là phổ biến và thường ít quan trọng hơn lời giải thích đi kèm với chúng.

segments.src: A forecast held steady because risks are balanced is different from one held steady despite growing concern.
segments.tr: Một dự báo được giữ ổn định vì các rủi ro đã cân bằng thì khác với một dự báo được giữ ổn định bất chấp mối lo ngại ngày càng tăng.

segments.src: ### 2. The balance of risks
segments.tr: ### 2. Sự cân bằng của rủi ro

segments.src: The IMF usually describes risks as tilted to the downside, the upside or roughly balanced.
segments.tr: IMF thường mô tả các rủi ro là nghiêng về phía giảm, phía tăng hoặc cân bằng đại khái.

segments.src: Pay attention to which factors it names.
segments.tr: Hãy chú ý đến những yếu tố mà họ nêu tên.

segments.src: Frequently cited candidates include:
segments.tr: Các ứng cử viên thường được trích dẫn bao gồm:

segments.src: - Persistently high long-term government bond yields
segments.tr: - Lợi suất trái phiếu chính phủ dài hạn duy trì ở mức cao

segments.src: - Trade restrictions and uncertainty about tariffs
segments.tr: - Các hạn chế thương mại và sự bất ổn về thuế quan

segments.src: - Energy price swings linked to ongoing conflicts
segments.tr: - Biến động giá năng lượng gắn liền với các cuộc xung đột đang diễn ra

segments.src: - Tightening or volatile financial conditions
segments.tr: - Thắt chặt hoặc biến động các điều kiện tài chính

segments.src: ### 3. Inflation and interest rates
segments.tr: ### 3. Lạm phát và lãi suất

segments.src: Whether inflation is cooling toward central bank targets affects how quickly borrowing costs might ease.
segments.tr: Việc lạm phát đang hạ nhiệt hướng tới các mục tiêu của ngân hàng trung ương ảnh hưởng đến tốc độ chi phí đi vay có thể giảm bớt.

segments.src: The IMF's commentary on the pace of disinflation, and on how far central banks should go in adjusting policy, is often one of the most closely read parts of the report.
segments.tr: Bình luận của IMF về tốc độ giảm lạm phát, và về mức độ mà các ngân hàng trung ương nên tiến hành điều chỉnh chính sách, thường là một trong những phần được đọc kỹ nhất của báo cáo.

segments.src: ### 4. Differences between regions
segments.tr: ### 4. Sự khác biệt giữa các khu vực

segments.src: Advanced economies, emerging markets and low-income countries often face very different conditions.
segments.tr: Các nền kinh tế tiên tiến, thị trường mới nổi và các quốc gia thu nhập thấp thường phải đối mặt với các điều kiện rất khác nhau.

segments.src: Watch for how the report treats Asia, which is hosting the meetings, as well as energy-importing economies that are more exposed to price shocks.
segments.tr: Hãy chú ý cách báo cáo đối xử với châu Á, nơi đăng cai các cuộc họp, cũng như các nền kinh tế nhập khẩu năng lượng dễ bị tổn thương hơn trước các cú sốc giá.

segments.src: ## The Bond Yield Question
segments.tr: ## Vấn đề lợi suất trái phiếu

segments.src: High yields on government debt matter well beyond bond traders.
segments.tr: Lợi suất cao đối với nợ chính phủ có tầm quan trọng vượt xa các nhà giao dịch trái phiếu.

segments.src: When governments pay more to borrow, interest costs take up a larger share of budgets, leaving less room for spending on public services, infrastructure or support during downturns.
segments.tr: Khi các chính phủ phải trả nhiều tiền hơn để đi vay, chi phí lãi vay chiếm phần lớn hơn trong ngân sách, để lại ít dư địa hơn cho chi tiêu cho các dịch vụ công, cơ sở hạ tầng hoặc hỗ trợ trong thời kỳ suy thoái.

segments.src: Higher yields can also spill over into mortgage rates, corporate borrowing and the exchange rates of other countries.
segments.tr: Lợi suất cao hơn cũng có thể lan sang lãi suất thế chấp, vay mượn của doanh nghiệp và tỷ giá hối đoái của các quốc gia khác.

segments.src: At the meetings, expect discussion of fiscal sustainability: how governments can put public finances on a steadier path without choking off growth.
segments.tr: Tại các cuộc họp, hãy kỳ vọng có các cuộc thảo luận về tính bền vững tài khóa: cách các chính phủ có thể đưa tài chính công đi theo con đường vững chắc hơn mà không làm bóp nghẹt tăng trưởng.

segments.src: The IMF has long encouraged credible medium-term plans, and the language it uses on this topic can hint at how urgent it considers the issue.
segments.tr: IMF từ lâu đã khuyến khích các kế hoạch trung hạn đáng tin cậy, và ngôn ngữ mà tổ chức này sử dụng về chủ đề này có thể gợi ý mức độ khẩn cấp mà họ coi trọng vấn đề này.

segments.src: ## Trade Friction
segments.tr: ## Xung đột thương mại

segments.src: Trade tensions are likely to feature in both formal sessions and informal conversations.
segments.tr: Căng thẳng thương mại có khả năng xuất hiện trong cả các phiên họp chính thức và các cuộc trò chuyện không chính thức.

segments.src: Key points to follow include:
segments.tr: Các điểm chính cần theo dõi bao gồm:

segments.src: - Whether the IMF quantifies the effect of trade barriers on growth and prices
segments.tr: - Liệu IMF có định lượng ảnh hưởng của các rào cản thương mại đối với tăng trưởng và giá cả hay không

segments.src: - How officials describe the risk of fragmentation into competing economic blocs
segments.tr: - Cách các quan chức mô tả rủi ro phân mảnh thành các khối kinh tế cạnh tranh

segments.src: - Any calls to strengthen or reform the rules-based trading system
segments.tr: - Bất kỳ kêu gọi nào nhằm củng cố hoặc cải cách hệ thống thương mại dựa trên luật lệ

segments.src: Because the outlook depends partly on policy decisions that can change quickly, forecasts in this area carry a high degree of uncertainty.
segments.tr: Vì triển vọng phụ thuộc một phần vào các quyết định chính sách có thể thay đổi nhanh chóng, các dự báo trong lĩnh vực này mang mức độ bất định cao.

segments.src: Treat precise numbers as estimates, not predictions.
segments.tr: Hãy coi các con số chính xác là ước tính, không phải dự đoán.

segments.src: ## Energy Costs and Conflict
segments.tr: ## Chi phí năng lượng và Xung đột

segments.src: Energy markets remain sensitive to geopolitical events.
segments.tr: Thị trường năng lượng vẫn nhạy cảm với các sự kiện địa chính trị.

segments.src: Higher fuel and power costs weigh on households and firms, and they hit importing countries hardest.
segments.tr: Chi phí nhiên liệu và điện cao hơn đè nặng lên các hộ gia đình và doanh nghiệp, và chúng giáng đòn mạnh nhất vào các nước nhập khẩu.

segments.src: The meetings may highlight how energy prices feed into inflation, and how governments can protect vulnerable people without adding to fiscal strain, for example through targeted support instead of broad subsidies.
segments.tr: Các cuộc họp có thể nhấn mạnh cách giá năng lượng tác động vào lạm phát, và cách các chính phủ có thể bảo vệ những người dễ bị tổn thương mà không làm gia tăng áp lực tài khóa, ví dụ thông qua hỗ trợ có mục tiêu thay vì trợ cấp rộng rãi.

segments.src: ## Debt and Development
segments.tr: ## Nợ và Phát triển

segments.src: Beyond the global outlook, the World Bank and IMF will use the meetings to discuss the position of lower-income and developing countries.
segments.tr: Ngoài triển vọng toàn cầu, Ngân hàng Thế giới và IMF sẽ sử dụng các cuộc họp để thảo luận về vị thế của các quốc gia có thu nhập thấp và đang phát triển.

segments.src: Themes likely to come up include:
segments.tr: Các chủ đề có khả năng xuất hiện bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Debt restructuring.** Progress, or the lack of it, in the multilateral frameworks used to restructure unsustainable debts, and how quickly agreements are reached.
segments.tr: - **Tái cơ cấu nợ.** Tiến triển, hoặc sự thiếu tiến triển, trong các khuôn khổ đa phương được sử dụng để tái cơ cấu các khoản nợ không bền vững, và mức độ nhanh chóng đạt được các thỏa thuận.

segments.src: - **Financing for development.** How to mobilize more money for health, education, energy access and climate resilience when public budgets are stretched.
segments.tr: - **Tài chính cho phát triển.** Cách huy động thêm tiền cho y tế, giáo dục, khả năng tiếp cận năng lượng và khả năng chống chịu khí hậu khi ngân sách công bị căng thẳng.

segments.src: - **Role of private capital.** Whether guarantees, concessional loans and other tools can attract more private investment into developing economies.
segments.tr: - **Vai trò của vốn tư nhân.** Liệu các khoản bảo lãnh, cho vay ưu đãi và các công cụ khác có thể thu hút thêm đầu tư tư nhân vào các nền kinh tế đang phát triển hay không.

segments.src: - **Institutional reform.** Ongoing discussions about the lending capacity, governance and priorities of the institutions themselves.
segments.tr: - **Cải cách thể chế.** Các cuộc thảo luận đang diễn ra về năng lực cho vay, quản trị và các ưu tiên của chính các tổ chức.

segments.src: For many countries, the cost of servicing debt competes directly with spending on schools and hospitals.
segments.tr: Đối với nhiều quốc gia, chi phí trả nợ cạnh tranh trực tiếp với chi tiêu cho trường học và bệnh viện.

segments.src: Announcements that ease that trade-off, even modestly, can matter a great deal for the people affected.
segments.tr: Các thông báo làm giảm bớt sự đánh đổi đó, dù chỉ là một cách khiêm tốn, cũng có thể có ý nghĩa rất lớn đối với những người bị ảnh hưởng.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Coverage
segments.tr: ## Cách đọc các nội dung đưa tin

segments.src: A few habits help when the headlines arrive:
segments.tr: Một số thói quen hữu ích khi các tiêu đề tin tức xuất hiện:

segments.src: 1. **Read beyond the headline number.** Revisions of a few tenths of a percentage point are common and can reflect technical updates.
segments.tr: 1. **Đọc vượt ra ngoài con số tiêu đề.** Việc điều chỉnh một vài phần mười của một điểm phần trăm là phổ biến và có thể phản ánh các cập nhật kỹ thuật.

segments.src: 2. **Check the assumptions.** Forecasts rest on assumptions about policy, energy prices and financial conditions. If these change, the outlook can too.
segments.tr: 2. **Kiểm tra các giả định.** Các dự báo dựa trên các giả định về chính sách, giá năng lượng và điều kiện tài chính. Nếu những điều này thay đổi, triển vọng cũng có thể thay đổi.

segments.src: 3. **Separate signal from ceremony.** Communiqués are negotiated documents, and cautious wording often reflects compromise among many members.
segments.tr: 3. **Tách biệt tín hiệu khỏi nghi thức.** Các thông cáo là các tài liệu được đàm phán, và cách diễn đạt thận trọng thường phản ánh sự thỏa hiệp giữa nhiều thành viên.

segments.src: 4. **Look for follow-through.** The meaningful test is whether commitments made in Bangkok turn into concrete action in the following months.
segments.tr: 4. **Tìm kiếm sự theo dõi sát sao.** Thử thách có ý nghĩa là liệu các cam kết được đưa ra ở Bangkok có biến thành hành động cụ thể trong những tháng tiếp theo hay không.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm cốt lõi

segments.src: The Bangkok meetings are unlikely to resolve the pressures facing the world economy, but they will offer a useful snapshot of how the main global institutions see the road ahead.
segments.tr: Các cuộc họp ở Bangkok không có khả năng giải quyết các áp lực đang đối mặt với nền kinh tế thế giới, nhưng chúng sẽ cung cấp một cái nhìn tổng quan hữu ích về cách các tổ chức toàn cầu chính nhìn nhận con đường phía trước.

segments.src: The most informative signals will probably be the IMF's description of risks, its guidance on public finances and inflation, and any real movement on debt relief and development financing.
segments.tr: Các tín hiệu mang tính thông tin nhất có lẽ sẽ là mô tả của IMF về các rủi ro, hướng dẫn của tổ chức này về tài chính công và lạm phát, cùng với bất kỳ chuyển động thực tế nào về giảm nhẹ nợ và tài financing phát triển.

segments.src: Readers should treat the outcomes as one input among many, and remember that forecasts are best understood as informed estimates in an uncertain environment.
segments.tr: Độc giả nên coi kết quả là một đầu vào trong số rất nhiều đầu vào, và nhớ rằng các dự báo được hiểu rõ nhất là các ước tính có cơ sở trong một môi trường bất định.
